title: IMPLICIT-Bench: Measuring Implicit Bias in Text-to-Image Models under Neutral Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from structured knowledge-graph based prompt triplets (neutral, stereotype, anti-stereotype) and evaluating the outputs using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and CLIP to measure stereotype lean.
